name: Draggable Minimap
creator: moga
description:
#### To enable map movement, you must, after moving your map, toggle your map scale!

### Overview:
Prefix your fantome with the letter `Z` to override any of my other mods that edit the map!

TURN OFF MAP MOVEMENT BECAUSE THE MOVEMENT HITBOX IS HARDCODED POS (if u didnt read the red text ofc)

* The draggable anchor is the small red box embedded inside the top right corner of the minimap.
* Features a slightly adjusted frame to appear less ugly.
* You need to drag the map into position at the start of each game.
* Works fine as a supplement to my [Top Minimap](https://runeforge.dev/mods/1fde87b9-cbe7-4860-884f-2efac9019ac5) and Minimap portion of the [UW accessibility](https://runeforge.dev/mods/238558cf-0827-4fc7-b1bf-908986101b7e) mods.

Please report bugs
